name: What are the key differences between modern and traditional landscape design?
description: Modern design emphasizes minimalism and geometric forms, while traditional design focuses on organic shapes, lush plantings, and classical elements.

mainEntity.name: What are the key differences between modern and traditional landscape design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern landscape design favors minimalism, geometric shapes, and a limited plant palette, focusing on creating structured, architectural outdoor spaces. It often uses materials like concrete, steel, and clean-cut stone. Traditional design, in contrast, embraces organic forms, lush and diverse plantings, and more classical elements such as intricate pathways, ornate fountains, and a sense of established charm. While modern aims for sleek integration, traditional often seeks a picturesque, naturalistic feel, or a formal, classical garden look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modern design emphasizes minimalism and geometric forms, while traditional design focuses on organic shapes, lush plantings, and classical elements.
